note: Mission Composer layer 3 (vision plan 4.1): complications. Each changes how the job plays, not only its text. {requester}, {hours} and {extra} are filled in code. Investigations get none yet: they are accepted through a checkpoint that allows no up-front money.

complications.text: It has to be there within {hours} hours, or it is no use to anyone. Done in time, the pay is better.
There is a window between storm fronts, about {hours} hours. After that the lanes close.
{requester} pays part of it up front, {extra} credits now. Less at the end; that is the deal.
They are not flying alone. Expect one more than the report says; the fee reflects it.
The order grew overnight. Half as much again, for more money.
